primarySourceFindings: HE retained/current PDF bytes equal; actual full printed16,17,26 inspected. HE9.1 mole/units/molar mass/Avogadro/gases/equations; HE10.4 qualitative hydrocarbon elemental analysis.
HE9.1 printed17 labels gas-volume molecular-formula derivation and stoichiometric calculations optional; do not turn them into universal earlier prerequisites.

BY8NTG C8.3.6 includes relative atomic masses; BY9other C9.3.6 demands molecular formula from data only. Exact mapping of the whole larger canonical scope to the latter needs a targeted boundary decision.
BY8NTG C8.4.6 includes given molecular-ion formulas; BY9other C9.4.7 specifies binary salts. Both include salt-property explanations; keep that requirement.
BY10 C10.1.10 directly demands half and overall equations. This grounds the current DE reaction goal second clause; do not attribute it to the basic HE9 clause.
Historical HE constant L=6.023e23 remains source history; new task data uses present exact/appropriately rounded NA, not a historical-source rewrite.
